reason: I lost a $9,000 kitchen job last month because nobody chased the quote, and a text follow-up on day 1, 3, 7 and 14 is exactly that gap. $2,000 plus $249 a month is small next to one lost job, the demo is free, and the setup fee comes back if it doesn't capture 10 calls.
objection: It only books into Google Calendar and not the software I actually run jobs and quotes in, so I don't know how it would know a quote went out. I also want to know where my customers' recordings and info are stored, and it's one guy doing the setup and the watching.
would_change_my_mind: If the demo call log shows I miss too few calls for this to pay, or the Québec French on the test calls sounds stiff or fake, I walk away.
